content: In chapter 3 the dissertation says that during the retirement of 817-25/1414-22 in Shiraz and Yazd Ibn Turka produced the Mafāḥiṣ and his lettrist commentary on the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam; the first trial in Herat in 825/1422 ended that period. It adds that the minor lettrist treatises date mostly from 828/1425 to 831/1428, a period in which he 'twice stood trial and was exiled'. The timeline (pdf 52) by contrast queries whether the Mafāḥiṣ was completed in Isfahan or Yazd in 823/1420.
